resources.string: Ask for a PIN when the app opens and after the time below in the background. A forgotten PIN can be reset outside the app.
The app lock hides the app, but it does not encrypt the library folder. Anyone who can open the files can read them.
Close the app and delete the app-lock entries from %1$s, or delete that file to reset all settings.

If you forget your PIN, unlock with this device’s biometrics or screen lock. If neither is available, clearing the app’s data removes the lock, and with it everything the app keeps only on this device: its settings, assistant chats, cloud connection and changes not yet synced to the cloud. A library folder in this device’s storage is kept.
You can also unlock with this device’s biometrics or screen lock.
The PIN must have at least 4 characters.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
Turning the app lock off or changing it needs the current PIN first.
